facts.fact: FB Attorneys reports that the Personal Data Protection Commission, established under the Personal Data Protection Act, Cap. 44, delivered a ruling in Complaint No. PDPC/CMP/002/2025, so the body was acting.
FB Attorneys reports a Commission ruling of 19 August 2025 enforcing the Personal Data Protection Act, Cap. 44, as law in force.

The ruling, as reported by FB Attorneys, applied Regulations 17 (right to erasure) and 18 (children's data in commercial advertisements) of the Personal Data Protection (Personal Data Collection and Processing) Regulations.

facts.fact: FB Attorneys reports the Commission's ruling of 19 August 2025 in Complaint No. PDPC/CMP/002/2025 against an Instagram business-page respondent (not named in the article): TZS 20 million damages to the complainant, a TZS 5 million fine payable to the Commission, and deletion of a newborn's photos within 14 days.
